text_blocks.snippet: Bowel cancer symptoms in men can include changes in bowel habits, rectal bleeding, abdominal pain or cramping, fatigue, and unexplained weight loss. It's important to note that these symptoms can also be caused by other conditions, but it's crucial to consult a doctor for proper diagnosis and treatment, especially if symptoms persist or worsen.

text_blocks.snippet: Here's a more detailed look at the potential symptoms:

list.title: Altered frequency:
list.snippet: Diarrhea, constipation, or a feeling that the bowel doesn't empty completely.

list.title: Changes in stool:
list.snippet: Narrower stools, or a change in the consistency of stools (e.g., pencil-thin stools).

list.title: Urgency:
list.snippet: A sudden and persistent urge to have a bowel movement, even when there's no real need.
